FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A09
A Type 1 permit is for someone who has never been licensed and lasts up to 2 years, while a Type 2 permit is for a licensed driver changing class and lasts up to 180 days. [A09]
Why it matters: group_hint permit-types; prereq_hint sec02-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F06, sec02-F07.
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A09
The minimum permit age for applicants under 25 is 15 years and 9 months, which differs from the Type 2 permit minimum of 16 years and 6 months. [A09]
Why it matters: group_hint permit-ages; prereq_hint sec02-R01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F09, sec02-F07.
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A10
Supervised practice is 60 hours with 10 at night for applicants under 25, but 14 hours with 3 at night for applicants 25 and older. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint practice-hours; prereq_hint sec02-F13; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F12, sec02-F14.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A10
The violation-free holding period is 9 months for a permit holder under 18 but 3 months for an 18-year-old with a diploma or GED or anyone aged 19 to 24, and 45 days applies to applicants 25 and older. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint holding-periods; prereq_hint sec02-F08; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec02-F15, sec02-F17, sec02-F18.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A10
A moving-violation conviction, a PBJ or a suspension sets a 9-month holding period counted from the latest such date at any age, which is separate from the age-based minimums. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint holding-periods; prereq_hint sec02-R04; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec02-F16, sec02-F17.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A10
The permit stage requires a supervising driver in the car, whereas the provisional stage allows driving alone but with restrictions such as no passengers and no night driving. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint license-stages; prereq_hint sec02-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F19.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A11
The full Driver's License needs three things at once: age 18 or older, at least 18 months on the Provisional License, and a clean moving-violation record for the past 18 months. [A11]
Why it matters: group_hint license-stages; prereq_hint sec02-F20; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F23, sec02-F20.
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A11
Graduation to the full license happens automatically by mail, and the mailed card is carried together with the Provisional License rather than replacing it. [A11]
Why it matters: group_hint license-stages; prereq_hint sec02-R07; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F24.
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A11
A parent or guardian is the normal co-signer for a minor, a spouse aged 18 or older may co-sign for a married minor, and a responsible adult such as an employer is allowed only when none of those exists. [A11]
Why it matters: group_hint co-signers; prereq_hint sec02-F10; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F25, sec02-F26.
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A12
Using an interpreter is free at the MVA, yet the interpreter's own services are paid by you, and in a language the test is offered in you need at least 5 attempts first. [A12]
Why it matters: group_hint accommodations; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F31, sec02-F32.
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0012]
